method.comparison: For each listed strict-above strike, current TSA mean > strike implies YES; compare with Kalshi result.
method.strike_parser: Numeric million or exact integer from rules_primary; floor_strike fallback.
method.expiration_value_normalization: Comma-formatted persons, or decimal values below 10 interpreted as millions after Kalshi schema/unit transition. Non-numeric strings are unparseable.
method.dedupe: Union /historical and current settled KXTSAW results by ticker; current receipt wins.

summary.scope: Source-contract audit only; no quotes, forecasts, model probabilities, or trading returns.

disagreement_events.rules_primary: If weekly average TSA airport screenings are above 2.25 million for the week ending October 23, 2022, according to the TSA, then the market resolves to Yes.
disagreement_events.rules_secondary: The Contract will expire at the sooner of the first 10:00 AM following the release of the data for October 23, 2022, or one week after October 23, 2022. The Last Trading Date and Time will always be 11:59 PM on October 23, 2022.
